title: Opening chatter and interview setup
summary: Interviewer settles in, mentions the Bluebird Cafe and notes the date, 13 Aug 1989, for an interview about Louis Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places

blocks.x: Okay. I have all my notes here. All right. Written on the best, one of the best eating establishments in New Orleans. I wrote my notes out this morning while eating breakfast at the Bluebird Cafe. Where's that?
Right on Pretend. Don't go on Saturday or Sunday.

It's crowded. So we can do it this way. Okay. What's today's date? Today's the August? 13th. 13th of August, 1989. Interview with Al Rose about Louis Armstrong. Okay. I'm just going to roll with it here. Diana. Oh, Diana Rose is here too. Besides Al. Quiet. She's going to be quietly here.
